2026_02_IND_KC.headline: Indianapolis tests Kansas City’s compromised protection in an Arrowhead efficiency battle
2026_02_IND_KC.paragraph1: Indianapolis arrives without Ashton Dulin, while Kansas City ruled out tackle Josh Simmons and defensive back Chamarri Conner and listed Chris Jones questionable with a calf issue. Patrick Mahomes finished the week as a full participant despite his knee listing. The Colts need Jonathan Taylor and Daniel Jones to preserve offensive balance and shorten third downs; Kansas City must protect Mahomes against disruption while generating enough interior pressure to keep Indianapolis from controlling pace through its run game.
2026_02_IND_KC.model_rationale: Kansas City’s offensive protection and defensive interior health meet an Indianapolis attack that is most dangerous when Taylor keeps the offense out of long-yardage situations.
